parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Considering the advantages and at least one disadvantage, explain which one of the three
countries Brit might choose as the most suitable to visit.
You should concentrate on your chosen country and not refer to the other countries.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Considering three disadvantages and one advantage, explain which one of the three countries
Brit might consider the least suitable to visit.
You should concentrate on your chosen country and not refer to the other countries.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Which one piece of the additional information provided did you find the least relevant when
explaining why Brit might make these choices?
Justify your response.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Which two statements made in the managing director’s column are exaggerations of Exlun
Industries’ current position?
Justify your choices, answering in about 30 words.
Section B
Read the material for Section B in the insert before answering the questions in Section B.

parts.text:
Identify the reason given to explain why cautious people might like living in Britain, as stated
in the first paragraph.

reintroduction of wolves in the UK.
